subject: Re: [AMBER] To calculate the volume of an octahedral box

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
You should be able to use the 'volume' command in cpptraj.
parm myparm.parm7
trajin mycoords.rst7
volume V0 out volume.dat
run
-Dan
On Thu, Jul 31, 2025 at 2:34 PM MAMTA YADAV via AMBER <amber.ambermd.
org> wrote:
